description: Writes a service's sessions and bookings. "createSlot" opens a session, or a repetition with `repeat`; "updateSlot" / "deleteSlot" act on one case, the following or all (`scope`); "cancel" a booking; "move" it to another session (no charge, no refund); "cancelSession" cancels it for everyone, refunding their credits or money; "chatPost" writes in its chat; "changeStanding" moves a client's standing place (a recurring place bought as a product) to another repetition. Whatever refunds (cancel unless refund false, cancelSession, deleteSlot, updateSlot with repeat) does nothing, not even the cancel, until the owner approves the `approveUrl` it answers (panel, 24 h). Closing days: neblla_business close; reads: neblla_booking_read. More: neblla_get_llms tools/booking

action.description: What to do. By action: cancel {set, booking, refund?}; move {set, booking, toSlot}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

booking.description: The booking's id, from neblla_booking_read list.

capacity.description: createSlot / updateSlot: places in the session.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

min.description: createSlot / updateSlot: fewest people for the session to take place.

productId.description: changeStanding: the product that sells the standing place.

reason.description: cancelSession: why, shown to the clients.

refund.description: cancel: false gives nothing back and runs at once; otherwise an approval link (refunded within the service's deadline).

repeat.description: createSlot / updateSlot: { freq: "daily"|"weekly"|"monthly"|"yearly", interval?, byDay? (["TU","TH"]), count? (total sessions) or until? } or an RRULE string.

resource.description: createSlot / updateSlot: the resource's id; null removes it.

scope.description: updateSlot / deleteSlot: "one" (default), "following" or "all" not started; repeat changes need following or all.

series.description: The id of a repeating series, from neblla_booking_read series.

site.description: createSlot / updateSlot: the site's id (neblla_business_read list); null removes it.

skipBusy.description: createSlot: leave the busy dates out of a repetition instead of failing with "busy".

slot.description: The session's id, from neblla_booking_read slots.

staff.description: createSlot / updateSlot: the professional's id; null removes it.

title.description: createSlot / updateSlot: a title for the session.

toSlot.description: move: the session to move the booking to.

name: neblla_booking
title: Manage bookings and sessions
